preamble: `conversation` is a chat in which a person describes the billet they want to start, a digital greeting card; the last entry is the new message. `billet` in an assistant entry is the start configuration offered so far.

template.instructions: Which template should the billet start from? Answer KEEP unless the new message names an occasion or asks for a different template.

criteria.KEEP: The new message names no occasion and does not ask for a different template.
criteria.valentinstag: Valentine's Day, love for a partner or sweetheart (Valentinstag, Liebe).
criteria.weihnachten: Christmas, the holidays, winter greetings (Weihnachten, Feiertage).
criteria.hochzeit: A wedding or a wedding anniversary (Hochzeit, Hochzeitstag).
criteria.muttertag: Mother's Day, thanks to a mother (Muttertag).
criteria.BLANK: A greeting card for an occasion none of these templates is made for, such as a farewell, a baptism, a thank-you, get well soon or Easter, or a blank start (andere Anlässe, leeres Billet).
criteria.NOT_SUPPORTED: The new message is not about a greeting card at all: a question, small talk or a different task.

theme.instructions: Which design theme fits the look the conversation asks for? Light or dark does not count here, that is `colorMode`. Answer KEEP unless the new message says something about colours, mood or style. TEMPLATE_DEFAULT is the template's own theme.

criteria.KEEP: The new message says nothing about colours, mood or style.
criteria.TEMPLATE_DEFAULT: The look the template comes with.
criteria.rose: Cream with dusty rose and a classic serif; tender, heartfelt, classic (Creme und Altrosé; zärtlich, herzlich, klassisch).
criteria.sage: Soft sage green; calm, natural, gentle (Salbeigrün; ruhig, natürlich, sanft).
criteria.midnight: Night blue with gold and fine lettering; elegant, festive, chic (Nachtblau mit Gold; elegant, festlich, schick).
criteria.paper: Old paper with dark red ink and a book serif; understated, literary, timeless (altes Papier mit dunkelroter Tinte; schlicht, literarisch, zeitlos).
criteria.lavender: Lilac and violet; dreamy, soft, light (Flieder und Violett; verträumt, sanft, leicht).
criteria.ocean: Sea blue and turquoise; fresh, clear, airy, modern (Meeresblau und Türkis; frisch, klar, luftig, modern).
criteria.terracotta: Burnt orange and clay; warm, earthy, Mediterranean (Terrakotta und gebranntes Orange; warm, erdig, mediterran).
criteria.graphite: Grey with steel blue; sober, minimalist, businesslike (Grau und Stahlblau; sachlich, minimalistisch, geschäftlich).
criteria.mint: Mint and teal with rounded letters; fresh, cheerful, friendly (Minze und Petrol; frisch, fröhlich, freundlich).
criteria.peach: Peach and coral with a bold headline; sunny, cheerful, playful (Pfirsich und Koralle; sonnig, fröhlich, verspielt).
criteria.aurora: Violet and cyan like the northern lights; magical, modern (Violett und Cyan wie Polarlicht; magisch, modern).
criteria.espresso: Coffee browns with a strong narrow headline; cosy, warm, relaxed (Kaffeebraun; gemütlich, warm, entspannt).
criteria.sakura: Cherry-blossom pink with an elegant script; romantic, delicate (Kirschblütenrosa; romantisch, zart).
criteria.forest: Deep forest green; natural, grounded, outdoorsy (Waldgrün; naturverbunden, bodenständig).
criteria.dune: Sand and ochre gold; warm, refined, elegant (Sand und Ockergold; warm, edel, elegant).
criteria.neon: Hot pink and electric cyan with loud display letters; party, very colourful, bold (Neonpink und Cyan; Party, knallbunt, laut).

particles.instructions: Which particles should float over the billet? Answer KEEP unless the new message mentions particles or something floating or falling. TEMPLATE_DEFAULT is the template's own particles.

criteria.KEEP: The new message says nothing about particles.
criteria.TEMPLATE_DEFAULT: The particles the template comes with.
criteria.NONE: No particles at all, for a calm billet (keine Partikel).
criteria.NOT_SUPPORTED: Particles are named, but none of those listed here, such as stars or bubbles.

divider.instructions: Which ornament should separate the sections of the billet? Answer KEEP unless the new message mentions dividers, separators or ornaments. TEMPLATE_DEFAULT is the template's own divider.

criteria.KEEP: The new message says nothing about dividers or ornaments.
criteria.TEMPLATE_DEFAULT: The divider the template comes with.

colorMode.instructions: Should the billet be shown light or dark? Answer KEEP unless the new message asks for light or dark.

criteria.KEEP: The new message says nothing about light or dark.
criteria.auto: Light or dark as the viewer's device is set (automatisch).
criteria.dark: A dark page, dark mode (dunkel, Dunkelmodus).

lang.instructions: In which language should the texts of the billet be? A language named for the billet always counts. Otherwise only the first message that describes the billet counts, by the language it is written in; later messages change the language only when they name one. Answer KEEP unless the new message decides the language this way.

criteria.KEEP: The new message does not decide the language.
criteria.UI_LANGUAGE: The language cannot be told: none is named, and the description is written in neither German nor English.

model.instructions: Which 3D model should the billet show? Answer KEEP unless the new message names an object, a gift or a motif to show, or asks for none. TEMPLATE_DEFAULT is the template's own model.

criteria.KEEP: The new message names no object to show.
criteria.TEMPLATE_DEFAULT: The model the template comes with.

model.unsupported: An object is named, but none of those listed here, such as a unicorn or a car.
